description.content: Assemble each session's system prompt and tool whitelist from the YAML frontmatter of AGENTS.md and SKILL.md, a bound custom mode, and live runtime probes. Pinned rules are never truncated, scoped rules are budgeted by byte size, and a per-session guard rejects tools outside the whitelist.
按 AGENTS.md / SKILL.md 的 YAML 头部规则、已绑定的自定义模式与运行时探测，为每个会话动态拼装系统提示词与工具白名单：pinned 规则固顶不截断，scoped 规则按字节预算裁剪，白名单外的工具由会话守卫拒绝。
